news.headline: Press Release: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
Delcath's global Phase 2 trial doses first patient in breast cancer
Delcath Systems Inc reports results for the quarter ended June 30 - Earnings Summary
Delcath Systems (NASDAQ: DCTH) posts Q2 profit and builds oncology pipeline
Delcath Systems Reports 20% Revenue Growth and Raises 2026 Outlook
Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million, up from $24.2 million a year earlier, on roughly 30% growth in HEPZATO KIT treatment volume, and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million; the company ended the quarter with $95.9 million in cash and investments and no debt. Management also cited new investigator-presented data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate for percutaneous hepatic perfusion in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, supporting the ongoing Phase 2 DELUMA trial.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Host Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
news.summary: Delcath announced it would hold a conference call and webcast on August 6, 2026 at 8:30 AM ET to discuss financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The webcast was made accessible via ViaVid, with a replay available afterward.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath announced that company management will attend and present at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston, MA on August 11, 2026. The appearance is aimed at engaging institutional investors on the company's commercial and clinical progress.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted restricted stock units totaling 17,000 shares of common stock to four new employees who joined the company in May and June 2026, issued July 1, 2026 under its 2023 Inducement Plan. The RSUs vest one-third on the first anniversary of grant, with the remainder vesting in equal annual installments over the following two years.

news.headline: HEPZATO-KIT Market Forecast to 2034 Highlights Growth Drivers, Sales Potential and Competitive Landscape Across the 7MM
news.summary: A third-party pharma market-intelligence report assessed HEPZATO KIT's commercial outlook across the seven major markets (US, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, UK, Japan), forecasting country-level sales, peak-sales potential and pricing through 2034. It also reviewed pipeline expansion opportunities in liver cancer and cholangiocarcinoma alongside the competitive landscape.

catalysts.label: Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
catalysts.detail: Delcath management will present to institutional investors in Boston, MA, a venue the company has used previously to update on commercial execution and pipeline progress following the Q2 2026 beat and raise.

catalysts.label: Target of 40 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Delcath had 28 active US treatment centers as of Q2 2026 and is working toward a 40-center target by year-end 2026, a key driver of continued HEPZATO KIT volume growth after ~30% year-over-year volume growth in Q2.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: Following the raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $104-108 million issued with Q2 results, the next quarterly report (typically early-to-mid November based on prior-year cadence) will show whether volume and treatment-center activation continue tracking toward that target.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 trial enrollment (liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer)
catalysts.detail: Following the first patient dosed in July 2026, continued enrollment across ~20 US and European sites in the ~90-patient randomized trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care is a pipeline catalyst to watch, bolstered by supportive retrospective data (60% hepatic partial response rate) presented at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026.

catalysts.label: Colorectal and other liver-dominant indication expansion
catalysts.detail: Delcath continues to advance investigator-initiated and company-sponsored studies of HEPZATO/CHEMOSAT in additional liver-dominant cancers (including colorectal cancer, under an FDA-cleared IND, and investigator-initiated trials in uveal and cutaneous melanoma presented at ASCO 2026), representing longer-term label-expansion optionality beyond uveal melanoma.

pulse: Delcath delivered a strong Q2 2026 beat on August 6, reporting revenue of $29.1 million (up from $24.2 million a year earlier) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, and raised full-year revenue guidance to $104-108 million from its prior $100 million floor, while ending the quarter with $95.9 million in cash and no debt. The company continues to expand beyond its approved uveal-melanoma indication, citing new ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 data (60% hepatic partial response rate) supporting its ongoing Phase 2 DELUMA trial in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, and remains on track toward its year-end target of 40 active US treatment centers versus 28 currently. With Q2 results now in hand, near-term focus shifts to the August 11 Canaccord Genuity conference appearance and continued site-activation execution through year-end.
